title: Localization and rescaling of a rectifiable varifold to an open subset
statement: Let V = v(M, θ) be a rectifiable n-varifold in U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} (U arbitrary), B ⊆ U open and c > 0. Then there is a rectifiable n-varifold W in B with carrier M ∩ B and multiplicity c·θ, whose weight is ofReal(c) • (μ_V restricted to B), whose support is B ∩ spt V, which has generalized mean curvature H in B whenever V has generalized mean curvature H in U, and with H locally in Lᵖ(μ_W) on B whenever H is locally in Lᵖ(μ_V) on U.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (B : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → B ⊆ U → 0 < c → ∃ W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ B, W.carrier = V.carrier ∩ B ∧ (∀ x, W.mult x = c * V.mult x) ∧ W.weight = ENNReal.ofReal c • V.weight.restrict B ∧ W.support = B ∩ V.support ∧ (∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → W.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H) ∧ (∀ (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), V.LocallyLp H p → W.LocallyLp H p)
